newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-BHP IRON ORE SAYS WEDLOCK TO RETIRE.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-BHP IRON ORE SAYS WEDLOCK TO RETIRE.

text.p: The Broken Hill Pty Co Ltd said on Thursday that Geoff Wedlock, the group general manager and executive vice president of BHP Iron Ore, planned to retire from the company, effective August 31.
Wedlock is the most senior executive at the iron ore division, whose operations are based in Western Australia, and which answers to the company's BHP Minerals group.
"An announcement about appointments to be made following Mr Wedlock's retirement will be made in the near future," the company said in a brief statement.
It said Wedlock had told BHP managing director John Prescott of his intention to retire and this agreed had been agreed.
His resignation follows the company's surprise announcement on Wednesday that the head of BHP Minerals, Dick Carter, would also retire on the same day.
